nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum UV SPF50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin generally say it doesn't add extra shine or clog pores and layers well under makeup, though a few note it can turn slightly oily by the end of a hot day or when used as a makeup base.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including some worried about looking greasy, report it sits well under makeup without an oily or heavy feel.
segments.dry: Reviewers recommend it for dry to combination skin and say it leaves skin feeling soft rather than dry or tight, with one dry-leaning reviewer confirming it doesn't worsen her dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one managing lupus-related facial redness, report the sunscreen is gentle and doesn't cause the stinging, irritation or breakouts they experience with other sunscreens.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes her skin as normal, sometimes leaning combination in summer, and lists this as her favorite year-round sunscreen for its lack of cast and light, hydrated feel.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the sunscreen as hydrating rather than drying, saying it leaves skin feeling soft, moisturized and comfortable throughout the day, including in hot and humid conditions.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones with sensitive eyes or lupus-related facial redness, say the sunscreen calms redness and causes none of the stinging or irritation they get from other sunscreens; a few others separately report mild eye stinging when the product gets too close to the eyes.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the sunscreen with helping repair and strengthen a damaged skin barrier.
concerns.spots: One reviewer who tracked her results over several weeks reports no sunburn and no new brown spots; two others specifically use the sunscreen to help guard against new sun spots and freckles.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or oily skin consistently say the sunscreen does not cause breakouts and doesn't feel congesting, even with daily use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers generally say it doesn't add extra oiliness or cause breakouts and layers well under makeup; a few note it can turn slightly shiny or oily over the course of a hot day or when worn as a makeup base, recommending powder to blot.

extraits.texte: When I first applied for the campaign I was so excited I was gonna get to try Korean sunscreen but upon receiving I read the ingredients & was put off from using it due to it having American sunscreen ingredients, this has Octocrylene, Homosalate as well as Avobenzone & Octisalate which are all bad for your skin & have been linked to to cause cancer also these harmful ingredients make this not reef safe

I'm on the constant lookout for new facial products. I have temperamental skin and always wanting to try something new that might work. This did pretty standard at hydration. Though I did enjoy the UV protection, it's a must nowadays. I have a neutral opinion about this, but if you are thinking of trying it, do it.

I was gifted the SKIN1004 water-fit sun serum in exchange for my honest opinion. I wear SPF daily, and makeup most days, with combination skin. I'm very fair so I often have issues with sunscreens leaving a blue cast on my skin. There are several things I really liked about this product from SKIN1004: 1.) the pump packaging fits nicely in your hand, and the pump makes it easy to "measure" how much I'm applying; 2.) the formulation is thick enough to not be messy, but serum-like enough to massage into my face and neck; 3.) no strong smell and doesn't require excessive rubbing to dry down or blend the color out. I tested the product in late July and felt the SPF protection was comparable to my typical SPF50 (no burns, no extra brown spots). I did notice that it tended to get oily throughout the day when used as a base for makeup, which didn't cause my foundation to slip but did require extra powder to blot. I got around this by setting the SPF with translucent powder prior to foundation. Overall this offering from SKIN1004 is a very nice and user friendly formula that would work for most people— I'd buy it again and have recommended it to a couple friends, especially those who don't wear makeup.

I have oily skin, and while this didn't make my skin overly oily, it definitely didn't help mattify it either. If you have oily skin like me, you'll probably want to wear powder over it or keep some blotting papers handy throughout the day. I did really like the consistency, though. It applied nicely, didn't leave a weird cast or any residue behind, and honestly just felt like a normal moisturizer on my skin.

I've been using this sunscreen for a while now, and overall, I really like it. I remember the texture feeling a little more lightweight and watery before, which I personally preferred for my oily skin, but I still find the current formula very comfortable to use. One of the biggest advantages for me is that it doesn't cause breakouts. That's especially important because I have oily, acne-prone skin, so finding a sunscreen that doesn't make my skin feel congested is a huge plus. It also works really well under makeup. I've tried it with foundations that have both water-based and silicone-based formulas, and my makeup applies smoothly over it either way. I don't have to worry about pilling or my foundation sitting unevenly, which makes this sunscreen very versatile for my everyday routine. I also love how easy it is to incorporate into my morning skincare routine. For me, it's especially useful during the hot Texas summer because I can get the sun protection I need without feeling like I'm putting a heavy layer on my oily skin. Would I buy it? Definitely. I would also recommend it to friends or family, especially anyone with oily or combination skin who wants a sunscreen that works well both on its own and under makeup.

extraits.titre: Most hydrating spf i have used
extraits.texte: I love the feel of this ultra hydrating sunscreen by SKIN1004. The Madagascar Centella instantly calmed my red distressed skin. Ir also delivers lightweight moisture without a sticky or heavy feel. It also helps repair and strengthen a damaged skin barrier.

What a game changer! As someone with lupus, this sun serum really changed a lot for me with my butterfly rash on my face. It's so gentle and hydrating, while also soothing and protecting. The packaging, the formula, everything. I loved it all!
